errata.location: README.md, Reading, third bullet ('The new best algebraic arm at k = 20 is t = 4, G = 3, seed 1193 with trace replay') and the 'L13 shows the base, not the solver, sets the w = 0 floor' clause; Headline last-but-one bullet ('3.5x ... on the algebraic track')
errata.issue: An unqualified rank. (a) AGENTS.md section 5a ranks two arms only where the order holds across w in {0,0.1,1}; the band verdict for t4-trace vs the T12 winner is 'unresolved inside the band' (winner 28.49 vs 44.64 at w=0, 1.567x cheaper), so t4-trace is better only at w >= 0.1. (b) The validated L13 control measured arms on the same isogeny base that cost far less than t4-trace at w=0.1: mitm-iso-t5-s1307 S=32.33 and grid-iso-t5-s1307 S=2,462.7 against 31,361 here (L13 itself calls them the algebraic track). The statement is only true among pkm-semaev F4 arms. (c) L13's 'base, not the solver, sets the floor' was measured on the t=5, 22-column base; T13 has no mitm/grid control on the t=4 base, so applying it to t=4 is an inference.
errata.fix: Write 'the best pkm-semaev (F4) arm measured so far at w >= 0.1; at w = 0 the T12 winner is 1.567x cheaper (band: unresolved)', and say that L13's base-versus-solver control was run at t = 5 only.

errata.location: README.md Headline and Reading; PROTOCOL.md predictions note 'counted F4 work'
errata.issue: The 3.5x and 0.474 are ratios in the counted unit (F_p multiply-adds, elimination only, plus group operations). The recorded wall time of the same runs does not follow: sum of online.wall_ns trace/plain = 0.869 (per pair 0.79 to 0.94, 16 of 16 pairs above 0.79), i.e. 260 ns against 141 ns per counted mul-add, so about half of the counted saving is not visible in wall time. Wall time is inadmissible here (PKM arms L0, host PSI-busy, sessions queued behind L12/L13) and the README makes no wall claim, so nothing is overclaimed, but a reader cannot tell that the replay's own overhead is uncounted, which bears on the engineering-versus-relabelling class of AGENTS.md section 3 (that classification is not stated in the README either).
errata.fix: Add one sentence: 'In these L0/L1, PSI-busy sessions the trace arm's recorded wall time is 0.87x the plain arm's (counted ratio 0.474); wall time is not admissible and no wall claim is made; replay bookkeeping outside the mul-add count is unpriced.' State the section-3 class (engineering at w >= 0.1 in the counted unit, with that caveat).
